ai_analysis.summary: A Data Engineer interview-preparation post for candidates with 3–5 years of experience. It lists questions covering SQL and data manipulation, Python for data engineering, Spark and PySpark, Azure data engineering, data modeling and warehousing, and behavioral experience. The post provides question prompts only; it does not include answers, SQL or Python code, technical explanations, examples, or performance figures, and the extracted media text is empty.
